# opencode-usage-dash

> Local-first dashboard for OpenCode usage: the rolling five-hour, weekly and monthly plan windows, with every dollar split by model, plus your latest sessions and what each one cost. It runs on your own machine and reads your own OpenCode data.

Key facts:

- Install: `npx opencode-usage-dash` (Node 23.4+), or run the container `ghcr.io/martinezharo/opencode-usage`
- Source code: https://github.com/martinezharo/opencode-usage (MIT)
- npm package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/opencode-usage-dash
- Plan percentages and reset times come from the OpenCode Go usage API; per-model costs, requests and tokens come from the OpenCode console API; recent sessions, their costs and models come from the local `opencode.db`, which also keeps it useful offline
- No account, no telemetry. The API key never leaves the machine; the server binds to `127.0.0.1` by default
- Plan caps are configurable (`--limits 20,50,100`) or removable (`--limits none`) for users without the Go plan
